snippet.title: Night Shift (2018) Trailer
snippet.description:
Play all my games at: https://patreon.com/puppetcombo/overview
Or preorder with paypal and get early access: https://puppetcombo.com/preorder

Night Shift (2018) - You take a job at a desolate convenience store and get put on the graveyard shift. As you try to work, you feel somebody watching from the distance... 

The prologue to Stay out of the House
